title: 手機使用
description: 手機使用相關的日常用語

sentences.en: My phone battery is almost dead.
sentences.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

sentences.en: Can I borrow your charger?
sentences.zh: 我可以借你的充電器嗎？

sentences.en: I just downloaded a new app.
sentences.zh: 我剛下載了一個新的 App。

sentences.en: I keep getting notifications from this app.
sentences.zh: 我一直收到這個 App 的通知。

sentences.en: Let me take a screenshot of this.
sentences.zh: 讓我截個圖。

sentences.en: Where do I change the settings?
sentences.zh: 我要在哪裡更改設定？

sentences.en: My phone storage is full.
sentences.zh: 我的手機儲存空間滿了。

sentences.en: I cracked my screen yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天把螢幕摔裂了。

sentences.en: Can you put your phone on silent mode?
sentences.zh: 你可以把手機調成靜音嗎？

sentences.en: I forgot my phone password.
sentences.zh: 我忘記手機密碼了。

sentences.en: The fingerprint sensor isn't working.
sentences.zh: 指紋感應器沒有反應。

sentences.en: I need to update my phone's operating system.
sentences.zh: 我需要更新手機的作業系統。

sentences.en: How do I turn on Bluetooth?
sentences.zh: 我要怎麼開啟藍牙？

sentences.en: My phone overheats when I play games.
sentences.zh: 我玩遊戲時手機會過熱。

sentences.en: I enabled Do Not Disturb mode.
sentences.zh: 我開啟了勿擾模式。

sentences.en: The camera quality on this phone is amazing.
sentences.zh: 這支手機的相機畫質很棒。

sentences.en: I transferred all my data to my new phone.
sentences.zh: 我把所有資料轉移到新手機了。

sentences.en: Swipe up to unlock the screen.
sentences.zh: 往上滑來解鎖螢幕。

sentences.en: I accidentally uninstalled the app.
sentences.zh: 我不小心把那個 App 刪掉了。

sentences.en: My phone vibrates but doesn't ring.
sentences.zh: 我的手機會震動但不會響。

sentences.en: I need to free up some space on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我需要清出一些手機空間。

sentences.en: Can you airdrop this photo to me?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這張照片 AirDrop 給我嗎？

sentences.en: I use face recognition to unlock my phone.
sentences.zh: 我用臉部辨識來解鎖手機。

sentences.en: The touchscreen is not responding.
sentences.zh: 觸控螢幕沒有反應。

sentences.en: I set a timer on my phone.
sentences.zh: 我在手機上設了一個計時器。

sentences.en: My phone automatically connects to this wifi.
sentences.zh: 我的手機會自動連接這個 WiFi。

sentences.en: I'm running out of mobile data.
sentences.zh: 我的行動數據快用完了。

sentences.en: The screen brightness is too high.
sentences.zh: 螢幕亮度太高了。

sentences.en: I cleared the cache to speed up my phone.
sentences.zh: 我清除了快取來加速手機。

sentences.en: Don't forget to charge your phone overnight.
sentences.zh: 別忘了晚上充手機的電。
